title: Painting Melting into Chaos
description: A framed painting leans against a wall on a green tiled floor, its canvas depicting a faint face sketch. A brown leather boot protrudes from the center of the canvas, with colorful red, blue, and green paint streams flowing and splashing outward, pooling on the floor.
prompt: Surreal scene of a wooden framed painting leaning against a purple wall on green tiled floor. A brown leather boot dramatically bursts through the center of the canvas which shows a faint blue face sketch. Vibrant red, blue, and green liquid paint streams swirl and splash out from the boot, flowing across the floor with dramatic god rays coming from the top right, in the style of a classical oil painting with visible brushwork
